offering_description.value: Provides software engineering, digital platform engineering, cloud, data, AI and consulting services to enterprises. Customers engage it on a project or time-and-materials basis. Work is delivered by globally distributed engineering teams.

primary_services.value: software engineering; digital and product design; cloud and data engineering; AI and consulting; testing and managed IT services

customer_segment.value: B2B: large enterprises in financial services, life sciences, retail, software, media, travel and consumer goods

end_markets.value: financial services; software and technology; life sciences and healthcare; retail and consumer goods; media and entertainment; travel

revenue_model.value: service fees: time-and-materials engineering and consulting billed per hour or team; project or contract: fixed-price software development and transformation projects

value_chain_position.value: service provider: supplies engineering talent and expertise to enterprise clients building and running digital systems

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia and other regions, with delivery centers across many countries

specialization.value: related lines: engineering, consulting, design, cloud, data and AI services for digital transformation

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: account teams selling directly to enterprise clients; partners / resellers: alliances with cloud and technology vendors

regulatory_exposure.value: low: normal business, data privacy and sanctions or export rules, clients in regulated industries impose compliance
